hero_subtitle: Guests scan a single QR code to snap and stream original high-res photos into your private event repository.
demo_title: From QR Code to Single-Click ZIP
demo_subtitle: Click through the interactive steps below to experience how Memly simplifies guest photo archives.
demo_step1_desc: Instantly generates your custom memory entrance and QR code.
demo_step2_desc: Guests scan using their default smartphone camera. No app download needed.
demo_step3_desc: Guests snap photos and write warm wishes inside the live viewfinder.
demo_step4_desc: Photos upload automatically in their original, uncompressed resolution.
demo_step5_desc: Download every high-resolution capture with a single click.
benefits_subtitle: Minimal dashboard operations, maximal emotional presences.
b1_desc: Guests hate sign-ups. Memly bypasses login barriers entirely. Tap a nickname and contribute.
b2_desc: No pixel compression. Original file sizes are preserved for print-ready memory archives.
b3_desc: Unlimited guest uploads. Gather hundreds of candid angles from tables and crowds simultaneously.
b4_desc: Albums are only accessible via QR scan. Your memory repository remains private to your attendees.
dash_desc: Monitor incoming streams, view guest logs, and oversee event access parameters.
test_subtitle: Memly captures the candid perspectives you shouldn't lose.
t1_quote: Everyone became part of our wedding album. We got over 600 authentic candid moments that our official photographer could never cover.
t2_quote: We didn't lose a single photo. Guests loved seeing their snaps populate the screens in real-time. It was incredibly simple.
t3_quote: We enjoyed the event instead of asking people for photos. Downloading the complete high-res ZIP file afterward was an absolute lifesaver.
faq1_a: No. Guests do not need to download an application or sign up for an account. They scan the QR code, type a nickname, and begin taking photos immediately.
faq2_a: Yes. All photos contributed by guests are uploaded in their full, original resolution without quality degradation or compression.
faq3_a: Absolutely. As the organizer, you can download all high-resolution photos in a single ZIP archive from your dashboard.
faq4_a: No. Memly supports unlimited guests and unlimited uploads for every event.
faq5_q: Can it be used for weddings?
faq5_a: Yes, weddings are our most popular events. Placing QR code stand cards on tables acts as a modern, digital alternative to disposable analog cameras.
login_subtitle: Relive and manage your shared memory archives.
register_subtitle: Create an organizer account to archive life's journeys.
admin_sub_overview: Manage your active event archives and guest contributions.
footer_tagline: Capturing life's shared memories with pure simplicity.
